meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline: 用 Astropy 进行天文与天体物理数据分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是天文学家或天体物理学家，需要处理天文数据。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are an astronomer or astrophysicist working with astronomical data.

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 能根据你的要求生成使用 Astropy 库的 Python 代码，帮你完成坐标转换、单位换算、FITS 文件处理、宇宙学计算、表操作等天文数据处理任务。
howto.when: 当你请求涉及天文数据分析、调试使用 Astropy 的代码，或询问坐标、单位、FITS、宇宙学、时间、表格、WCS 等具体功能时触发。

say.text: 把赤道坐标（10.5度，41.2度）转为银道坐标。
say.note: Claude 会给出 SkyCoord 转换代码。

say.text: 读一个 FITS 文件，显示它的结构和头信息。
say.note: Claude 会写用 fits.open 的代码。

say.text: 用 Planck18 模型算 z=1.5 的光度距离。
say.note: Claude 会给出 cosmology 计算代码。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can generate Python code using the Astropy library to perform astronomical data analysis tasks such as coordinate transformations, unit conversions, FITS file handling, cosmology calculations, etc., based on your requests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about astronomical data analysis, debugging code using Astropy, or request specific features like coordinates, units, FITS, cosmology, time, tables, or WCS.

say_en.text: Convert equatorial coordinates (10.5 deg, 41.2 deg) to galactic coordinates.
say_en.note: Claude will provide SkyCoord conversion code.

say_en.text: Read a FITS file, show its structure and header info.
say_en.note: Claude will write code using fits.open.

say_en.text: Compute luminosity distance at z=1.5 using Planck18.
say_en.note: Claude will give cosmology calculation code.
